calls.reason: The packet provides no comparison between the Apple puzzles and military strategy or molecular biology. The qualitative difficulty judgment cannot be established from the supplied evidence.

Lawsen acknowledged serious mistakes and satirical intent; the revision corrected substantive token and complexity arguments. That supports the main characterization, although the popularity ranking is unverified and one objection held up.

Schaeffer documents prediction difficulties, while Ruan and Gadre demonstrate successful advance predictions. These studies do not settle whether sufficient model size can generally be known for a given problem.

CodeRAG-Bench and the API evolution study show retrieval benefits alongside failures. Neither compares the claimed situations while establishing whether conceptual understanding explains the difference.

Apple reports complexity-related execution failures even with a supplied algorithm, and Anil documents failures beyond training lengths. Huang's conditional successes do not overturn the practical warning about dependable execution.
The packet identifies several corroborating candidates, but does not establish scores of qualifying papers. The forecast has no deadline, so the incomplete count cannot establish failure either.
